hypothesis: Measured command-aligned tracking plus persistent five-second options initialized at the strongest measured allocation baseline; only improvements beyond matched allocation and flat learning count.
observation_contract: command_aligned_tracked_v1; same measurements and requested-command history for every arm
option_target_identity: Latch measured target ID at initiation; re-resolve observed slot during execution; terminate when locally confirmed target disappears.
pretraining_revision: Registered after EXP0051 completed. No EXP0052 validation/confirmation scenes have been opened.
reward_provenance: Registered engineering normalization, not calibrated clinical utility. Identical reward in flat and hierarchical learning; physical zero-violation success is unchanged.
supervisor_provenance: Joint projection based only on tracked relative position/velocity and local lumen observations. Margins are uncalibrated engineering stress assumptions, not certified uncertainty bounds. Track loss and infeasibility are reported, not declared safe.

actuator_stress.definition: Synthetic off-diagonal velocity response alpha*exp(-distance/length), clipped by the same per-cluster command limit. Physics only; never an actor feature.

primary_gate: Original physical and measured completion plus zero realized contact and spacing violations; no relaxation of 2 mm threshold.
selection: No checkpoint or training-seed selection; all six fixed-budget learning runs reported. Confirmation remains unopened.
failure_rule: Retain every requested process attempt. Any failed evaluation blocks admitted ranking; diagnostic repeats never replace failures.
claims: No guarantees of learned superiority, hardware magnetic independence, or certified safety. Observer upgrades, initialization and heuristic projection alone are not learning gains.
nominal_prior: Exact measured balanced assignment with hysteresis, provided identically to the matched baseline; learned logits modify this prior. Initial deterministic policy equals that baseline.
sensor_ablation: Command history subtracted before drift filtering and integrated over image latency. Four unchanged preflight trajectories in two scenes showed smaller estimator residuals; this is not a learning contribution.
